whats_new: Fixed: yarn a twister sends on to a dyeing unit now shows in that unit's Yarn Dyeing Stock. Only the twister who made it was ever credited, so doubled yarn delivered anywhere else simply vanished from stock

Purchases now shows a DB ID for every line — the computer's own number for that purchase, to write beside it in your register. It never changes when you edit the bill, and a deleted one is never given to another purchase
Add Multiple Bills: enter several bills in one go, each row with its own date, supplier and bill no — for a stack of small bills that would otherwise be one dialog each
Purchases can be parked on DELIVERY PENDING when the bill is on file but the yarn has not come in. Those lines are shaded amber and count towards nobody's stock until you give them a real location
Awaiting Delivery button on the Purchases page answers "what have I bought that hasn't turned up yet?" in one click

New bills → picker beside Delete sets where every new purchase line starts. Park it on DELIVERY PENDING while entering bills for yarn in transit; the box turns amber so it cannot be left there by accident

Purchase lines take a DELIVERED ON date, and stock counts the yarn from that day rather than the bill date — so a bill entered today for yarn arriving next week no longer inflates today's stock. Leave it blank and the bill date is used, exactly as before
A dyeing unit or twister holding yarn only from a twisting delivery can now be picked in Job Stock Closures
Each party's saved address and default credit period now sync to the phone, so they show on the ledger in the Vyora app
Long ledgers can print just their oldest bills — totals stay exact
Ledger details now show the party's address and default credit period as saved in Tally
Average pay cycle: see how many days a party actually takes to pay — on the Outstanding list and above their bills, alongside the oldest bill due

Mark a bill as received while your accountant is yet to enter it in Tally — it comes off your outstanding and stays out of reminders, then clears itself once the entry lands (switch it on in Settings)
Items Stock can now be shared as a PDF — everything in one go kept group-wise, or just the group you are viewing
The version shown on the dashboard now always matches the app you have installed
Address and credit period need the Vyora Sync desktop agent on 2.0.33 or newer
